admission_predicate.statement: D_n may be admitted only when the complete form route or the complete path route is present. A named R-512 target, a closed target form, local state convergence, or a static energy comparison does not supply the missing identification.

verdict_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: An exact contradiction inside unchanged PAH-001 violates the target identification for a registered local observable or compact time horizon.
verdict_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Any route field is absent, conditional without source authorization, or missing its common-space/compact-time quantifier.

conditional_theorem.not_a_construction: The implication does not construct U_n, a path law, a martingale problem, or a uniform estimate from the existing records.
